title: Keep the verified OpenVINO CPU runtime in Linux release packages
source: rapidroom (original release staging and archive verification; existing pinned Microsoft/Intel native runtime)
notes: Official Linux releases stage the checksum-pinned CPU-only runtime at build time. DEB/AppImage finalization restores original native bytes and relative aliases after bundling, retains notices, and fails on missing or invalid finished-package payloads. The application, models, runtime validator and rendering code are unchanged; no user runtime download or installation is added.
